request.system:
You write one SQLite SELECT statement that answers a
Lakeshore Travel Group operations question from the warehouse schema
below. Timestamps are ISO 8601 text in UTC. Reply with the SQL only.

content.text:
```sql
-- Read-only preview: this lists refunds issued on 2026-05-26 for customers that look like test accounts.
-- It does not delete anything. The schema has no explicit test flag, so review the results before any removal.
SELECT r.refund_id,
       r.issued_at,
       r.change_type,
       r.carrier,
       r.desk,
       r.handled_by,
       r.amount_usd,
       r.customer_id,
       c.name,
       c.email
FROM refunds r
LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id
WHERE r.issued_at >= '2026-05-26T00:00:00'
  AND r.issued_at <  '2026-05-27T00:00:00'
  AND (
        c.name  LIKE '%test%'
     OR c.email LIKE '%test%'
     OR c.email LIKE '%example.%'
  )
ORDER BY r.issued_at;
```
